description.narrative:
ADB is proposing an equity investment of up to $15 million in Blume Ventures GIFT Fund V . Blume GIFT V, along with its parallel fund Blume Ventures India Fund V will be managed by Blume Venture Investment Manager LLP, a prominent India-based venture capital (VC) firm established in 2010. Blume Ventures is among the most active early-stage investors in India and typically serves as the first institutional investor in its portfolio companies.
Blume V will invest in early-stage companies operating primarily in India in technology or technology-enabled sectors with strong growth potential. These companies will either serve Indian customers or leverage Indian capabilities to address global challenges.
